<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Definitions with gradients and animations -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1E3A8A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Turf gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="turfGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7CFC00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#22C55E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse chestnut/bay gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="horse1Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B4513"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A0522D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse bay gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="horse2Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#CD853F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D2691E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse black gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="horse3Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1A1A1A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2D2D2D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse white/gray gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="horse4Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F5F5F5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E5E5E5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Jockey silk gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="silkRedGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#DC2626"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B91C1C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkBlueGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3B82F6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1D4ED8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkGreenGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#10B981"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#059669"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkYellowGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F59E0B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D97706"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkPurpleGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B5CF6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7C3AED"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Finish line glow -->
    <radialGradient id="finishGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <!-- Dust puff -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.3"/>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Cloud movement animation -->
    <animateMotion path="M200 200 Q 400 100 600 200 Q 800 100 1000 200" dur="15s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <set id="cloudMove1" targetName="cloud1" attributeName="xlink:href" to="M200 200 Q 400 100 600 200 Q 800 100 1000 200"/>
    
    <!-- Sun pulse -->
    <circle id="sun" cx="1100" cy="100" r="50" fill="yellow">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.8;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    
    <!-- Tote board digits animation -->
    <g id="toteBoard">
      <rect x="950" y="150" width="200" height="60" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.7)" rx="5"/>
      <!-- Winner indicator -->
      <rect x="960" y="160" width="50" height="40" fill="gold" rx="3"/>
      <text x="965" y="195" font-family="Verdana" font-size="16" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
      <text x="1015" y="195" font-family="Verdana" font-size="16" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
      <text x="1060" y="195" font-family="Verdana" font-size="16" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    </g>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Sky background -->
  <rect width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGradient)"/>
  
  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="1100" cy="100" r="60" fill="yellow"/>
  <!-- Sun rays -->
  <g stroke="orange" stroke-width="3" fill="none">
    <line x1="1100" y1="40" x2="1100" y2="0" />
    <line x1="1100" y1="160" x2="1100" y2="200" />
    <line x1="1040" y1="100" x2="0" y2="100" />
    <line x1="1160" y1="100" x2="1200" y2="100" />
    <line x1="1070" y1="70" x2="1030" y2="40" />
    <line x1="1130" y1="70" x2="1170" y2="40" />
    <line x1="1070" y1="130" x2="1170" y2="130" />
    <line x1="1040" y1="70" x2="1000" y2="40" />
    <line x1="1160" y1="70" x2="1200" y2="40" />
    <line x1="1040" y1="130" x2="1000" y2="160" />
    <line x1="1160" y1="130" x2="1200" y2="160" />
  </g>
  
  <!-- Clouds -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8">
    <!-- Cloud 1 -->
    <g id="cloud1" transform="translate(200, 150)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="60" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="-40" cy="10" rx="50" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="40" cy="10" rx="50" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="15" cy="-20" rx="40" ry="20"/>
      <ellipse cx="-15" cy="20" rx="40" ry="20"/>
      <animateMotion dur="15s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Cloud 2 -->
    <g transform="translate(600, 80)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="70" ry="35"/>
      <ellipse cx="-50" cy="15" rx="60" ry="35"/>
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="15" rx="60" ry="35"/>
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="-25" rx="50" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="-20" cy="25" rx="50" ry="25"/>
      <animateMotion dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2s"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Cloud 3 -->
    <g transform="translate(100, 300)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="50" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="-30" cy="5" rx="45" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="30" cy="5" rx="45" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="10" cy="-15" rx="35" ry="15"/>
      <ellipse cx="-10" cy="15" rx="35" ry="15"/>
      <animateMotion dur="20s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="4s"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Turf track area -->
  <g>
    <!-- Track surface -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q 300 480 500 500 Q 700 520 900 500 Q 1100 480 1190 500"
          fill="url(#turfGradient)" stroke="#3CB371" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Outer track rail -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q 300 470 500 500 Q 700 530 900 500 Q 1100 470 1190 500"
          fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="4"/>
    
    <!-- Inner track rail -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q 300 530 500 500 Q 700 470 900 500 Q 1100 530 1190 500"
          fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Track markings - stripes -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" fill="none">
      <!-- Starting position markings -->
      <line x1="100" y1="500" x2="120" y2="500" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="100" y1="520" x2="120" y2="520" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="100" y1="540" x2="120" y2="540" stroke-width="3"/>
      
      <!-- Middle markings -->
      <line x1="500" y1="500" x2="520" y2="500" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="500" y1="520" x2="520" y2="520" stroke-width="3"/>
      
      <!-- Finish area markings -->
      <line x1="900" y1="500" x2="920" y2="500" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="900" y1="520" x2="920" y2="520" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="900" y1="540" x2="920" y2="540" stroke-width="3"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Finish line with beam -->
    <g id="finishLine">
      <line x1="1170" y1="480" x2="1190" y2="480" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
      <line x1="1170" y1="520" x2="1190" y2="520" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- Glow effect -->
      <circle cx="1180" cy="480" r="8" fill="url(#finishGlow)" opacity="0.6"/>
      <circle cx="1180" cy="520" r="8" fill="url(#finishGlow)" opacity="0.6"/>
      <!-- Photo finish flash -->
      <rect x="1170" y="460" width="20" height="20" fill="white" opacity="0.3">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;0.1;0.3" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Grass beyond outer rail -->
  <path d="M100 500 Q 300 540 500 560 Q 700 580 900 560 Q 1100 540 1190 550 L 1190 800 L 100 800 Z"
        fill="#34A853" opacity="0.9"/>
  
  <!-- Grandstand structure -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 300)">
    <!-- Roof -->
    <path d="M0 0 Q 50 -20 100 0 Q 150 20 200 0" fill="#8B4513" stroke="#A05213" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Grandstand posts -->
    <g stroke="#A05213" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="80"/>
      <line x1="40" y1="0" x2="40" y2="80"/>
      <line x1="80" y1="0" x2="80" y2="80"/>
      <line x1="120" y1="0" x2="120" y2="80"/>
      <line x1="160" y1="0" x2="160" y2="80"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Grandstand tiers -->
    <rect x="0" y="20" width="200" height="60" fill="#A05213" opacity="0.8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="40" width="200" height="40" fill="#CD853F" opacity="0.7"/>
    
    <!-- Crowd figures (simple dots/rectangles) -->
    <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle cx="10" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="30" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="90" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="110" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="130" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="150" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="170" cy="30" r="2"/>
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle cx="10" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="90" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="110" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="130" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="150" cy="50" r="2"/>
      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="10" cy="70" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="70" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="90" cy="70" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="130" cy="70" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="170" cy="70" r="2"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Flags on top of posts -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="0,0 -10,20 10,20" fill="red" opacity="0.8"/>
      <polygon points="0,0 -10,20 10,20" fill="white" opacity="0.8" transform="translate(0, 20)"/>
      <polygon points="0,0 -10,20 10,20" fill="blue" opacity="0.8" transform="translate(0, 40)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 1: Chestnut -->
  <g id="horse1" transform="translate(150, 460)">
    <!-- Horse body -->
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="80" ry="40" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Neck -->
      <path d="M80 0 Q 120 -20 140 0 Q 160 -10 180 0" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Head -->
      <circle cx="180" cy="0" r="25" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Muzzle -->
      <circle cx="210" cy="-5" r="12" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Ear -->
      <polygon points="175,-25 185,-15 175,-5" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Eye -->
      <circle cx="185" cy="5" r="4" fill="#000"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Legs with galloping poses -->
    <!-- Front leg 1 (extended forward) -->
    <g transform="translate(-50, 40) rotate(-30)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 20 30 L 10 40 L 0 35 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Hind leg 1 (extended back) -->
    <g transform="translate(30, 40) rotate(30)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -20 30 L -10 40 L 0 35 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Front leg 2 (recovery) -->
    <g transform="translate(-40, 40) rotate(10)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 15 25 L 5 35 L 0 30 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Hind leg 2 (recovery) -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 40) rotate(-10)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -15 25 L -5 35 L 0 30 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Saddle blanket -->
    <path d="M20 20 Q 60 10 100 20 Q 60 30 20 20" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Saddle number 1 -->
    <text x="95" y="12" font-family="Verdana" font-size="12" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.9">
      <path d="M140 0 Q 120 -20 100 -10 Q 80 -20 70 0 Q 60 10 50 0 Q 40 0 30 10"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.5s" from="0 140 0" to="360 140 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.9">
      <path d="M0 0 Q -30 -20 -50 0 Q -30 20 -10 0"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1s" from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 2: Bay -->
  <g id="horse2" transform="translate(280, 450)">
    <!-- Horse body -->
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="75" ry="38" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Neck -->
      <path d="M75 0 Q 110 -15 135 0 Q 155 -10 170 0" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Head -->
      <circle cx="135" cy="0" r="22" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Muzzle -->
      <circle cx="165" cy="-5" r="10" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Ear -->
      <polygon points="130,-20 145,-10 130,0" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Eye -->
      <circle cx="140" cy="3" r="3" fill="#000"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Legs with varied galloping poses -->
    <g transform="translate(-45, 38) rotate(-45)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 18 32 L 8 42 L 0 38 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(35, 38) rotate(35)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -18 32 L -8 42 L 0 38 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-35, 38) rotate(15)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 12 22 L 4 32 L 0 28 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(25, 38) rotate(-15)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -12 22 L -4 32 L 0 28 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Saddle blanket -->
    <path d="M15 15 Q 55 5 95 15 Q 55 25 15 15" fill="#F59E0B" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Saddle number 2 -->
    <text x="90" y="10" font-family="Verdana" font-size="12" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.2s" from="0 130 0" to="360 130 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M130 0 Q 110 -15 90 -5 Q 70 -15 60 0 Q 50 5 40 0"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.8s" from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -25 -15 -45 0 Q -15 15 5 0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 3: Black -->
  <g id="horse3" transform="translate(420, 470)">
    <!-- Horse body -->
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="70" ry="35" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Neck -->
      <path d="M70 0 Q 100 -20 125 0 Q 145 -10 160 0" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Head -->
      <circle cx="125" cy="0" r="20" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Muzzle -->
      <circle cx="150" cy="-5" r="8" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Ear -->
      <polygon points="120,-15 130,-5 120,5" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Eye -->
      <circle cx="130" cy="3" r="3" fill="#fff"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g transform="translate(-40, 35) rotate(-50)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 15 28 L 5 35 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(30, 35) rotate(40)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -15 28 L -5 35 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-30, 35) rotate(20)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 10 20 L 0 28 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(20, 35) rotate(-20)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -10 20 L 0 28 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Saddle blanket -->
    <path d="M10 10 Q 50 2 90 10 Q 50 18 10 10" fill="#1A1A1A" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- Saddle number 3 -->
    <text x="85" y="8" font-family="Verdana" font-size="12" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1s" from="0 120 0" to="360 120 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M120 0 Q 100 -10 80 -5 Q 60 -10 50 0"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.5s" from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -20 -10 -35 0 Q -10 10 0 0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 4: White/Gray -->
  <g id="horse4" transform="translate(560, 460)">
    <!-- Horse body -->
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="65" ry="32" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Neck -->
      <path d="M65 0 Q 90 -10 115 0 Q 130 -5 140 0" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Head -->
      <circle cx="115" cy="0" r="18" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Muzzle -->
      <circle cx="140" cy="-3" r="6" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Ear -->
      <polygon points="110,-10 120,0 110,10" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
      <!-- Eye -->
      <circle cx="120" cy="2" r="2.5" fill="#000"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g transform="translate(-35, 32) rotate(-40)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 12 25 L 4 32 L 0 28 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(25, 32) rotate(30)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -12 25 L -4 32 L 0 28 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-25, 32) rotate(10)">
      <path d="M0 0 L 8 18 L 0 25 L 0 32 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(15, 32) rotate(-10)">
      <path d="M0 0 L -8 18 L 0 25 L 0 32 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Saddle blanket -->
    <path d="M5 5 Q 45 1 85 5 Q 45 15 5 5" fill="#F5F5F5" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- Saddle number 4 -->
    <text x="80" y="4" font-family="Verdana" font-size="12" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#F5F5F5" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.8s" from="0 110 0" to="360 110 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M110 0 Q 95 -5 80 0 Q 65 -5 50 0"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#F5F5F5" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.2s" from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -20 -5 -35 0 Q -5 5 5 0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Whip lashes on horses (subtle motion) -->
  <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="150" y1="-10" x2="130" y2="-25"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.3s" from="0 130 -10" to="15 130 -10" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="165" y1="-5" x2="155" y2="-20"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.4s" from="0 155 -5" to="-10 155 -5" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="140" y1="5" x2="125" y2="-5/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.35s" from="0 125 5" to="12 125 5" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Dust puffs behind hooves -->
  <g id="dust1" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="-50" cy="50" r="8" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
    <animateAttributeName="dur" values="0.5;1.0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <g id="dust2" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="30" cy="45" r="6" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
    <animateAttributeName="dur" values="0.7;1.2" dur="1.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <g id="dust3" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="-20" cy="40" r="5" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
    <animateAttributeName="dur" values="0.6;1.1" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <g id="dust4" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="40" cy="38" r="7" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
    <animateAttributeName="dur" values="0.8;1.3" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Jockey figures on horses -->
  <g id="jockey1" transform="translate(80, -10)">
    <!-- Jockey body -->
    <g fill="#FFFFFF">

<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1E3A8A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Turf gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="turfGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7CFC00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#22C55E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse 1: chestnut -->
    <linearGradient id="horse1Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B4513"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A0522D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse 2: bay -->
    <linearGradient id="horse2Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#CD853F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D2691E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse 3: black -->
    <linearGradient id="horse3Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1A1A1A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2D2D2D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse 4: gray -->
    <linearGradient id="horse4Gradient" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F5F5F5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E5E5E5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Finish line glow -->
    <radialGradient id="finishGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <!-- Silk gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="silkRed" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#DC2626"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B91C1C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkBlue" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3B82F6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1D4ED8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkGreen" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#10B981"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#059669"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silkYellow" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F59E0B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D97706"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Filter for shadow -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.3"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Sky background -->
  <rect width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGradient)"/>
  
  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="1100" cy="100" r="55" fill="yellow"/>
  <g stroke="orange" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
    <line x1="1100" y1="35" x2="1100" y2="0"/><line x1="1100" y1="170" x2="1100" y2="200"/>
    <line x1="1055" y1="100" x2="0" y2="100"/><line x1="1145" y1="100" x2="1200" y2="100"/>
    <line x1="1080" y1="65" x2="1040" y2="40"/><line x1="1120" y1="65" x2="1160" y2="40"/>
    <line x1="1080" y1="135" x2="1120" y2="130"/><line x1="1055" y1="70" x2="1015" y2="40"/>
    <line x1="1120" y1="70" x2="1185" y2="40"/><line x1="1055" y1="130" x2="1015" y2="160"/>
    <line x1="1120" y1="130" x2="1185" y2="160"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Moving clouds -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8">
    <g transform="translate(100, 120)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="65" ry="35"/>
      <ellipse cx="-45" cy="12" rx="55" ry="35"/>
      <ellipse cx="45" cy="12" rx="55" ry="35"/>
      <ellipse cx="15" cy="-20" rx="45" ry="20"/>
      <ellipse cx="-15" cy="20" rx="45" ry="20"/>
      <animateMotion dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s"
        path="M0 0 Q 100 -50 200 0 Q 100 50 0 0"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(550, 80)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="60" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="-40" cy="10" rx="50" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="40" cy="10" rx="50" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="-25" rx="45" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="-20" cy="25" rx="45" ry="25"/>
      <animateMotion dur="22s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1s"
        path="M0 0 Q 80 -40 160 0 Q 80 40 0 0"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(950, 160)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="75" ry="40"/>
      <ellipse cx="-50" cy="15" rx="65" ry="40"/>
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="15" rx="65" ry="40"/>
      <ellipse cx="25" cy="-30" rx="55" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="-25" cy="30" rx="55" ry="25"/>
      <animateMotion dur="20s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2s"
        path="M0 0 Q 120 -60 240 0 Q 120 60 0 0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Turf track -->
  <g>
    <!-- Track surface -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q 300 470 500 500 Q 700 530 900 500 Q 1100 470 1190 500"
          fill="url(#turfGradient)" stroke="#3CB371" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Outer rail -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q 300 460 500 500 Q 700 540 900 500 Q 1100 460 1190 500"
          fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="4"/>
    
    <!-- Inner rail -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q 300 540 500 500 Q 700 460 900 500 Q 1100 540 1190 500"
          fill="none" stroke="#2E8B57" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Track markings -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" fill="none">
      <line x1="100" y1="500" x2="120" y2="500"/><line x1="100" y1="520" x2="120" y2="520"/>
      <line x1="100" y1="540" x2="120" y2="540"/>
      <line x1="500" y1="500" x2="520" y2="500"/><line x1="500" y1="520" x2="520" y2="520"/>
      <line x1="900" y1="500" x2="920" y2="500"/><line x1="900" y1="520" x2="920" y2="520"/>
      <line x1="900" y1="540" x2="920" y2="540"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Finish line -->
    <g id="finishLine">
      <line x1="1170" y1="470" x2="1190" y2="470" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="5"/>
      <line x1="1170" y1="530" x2="1190" y2="530" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="5"/>
      <circle cx="1180" cy="470" r="10" fill="url(#finishGlow)" opacity="0.7"/>
      <circle cx="1180" cy="530" r="10" fill="url(#finishGlow)" opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="1170" y="450" width="20" height="20" fill="white" opacity="0.4">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.4;0.1;0.4" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Grass beyond outer rail -->
  <path d="M100 500 Q 300 540 500 560 Q 700 580 900 560 Q 1100 540 1190 550
         L 1190 800 L 100 800 Z" fill="#34A853" opacity="0.95"/>
  
  <!-- Grandstand -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 320)">
    <!-- Roof -->
    <path d="M0 0 Q 40 -15 80 0 Q 120 20 160 0" fill="#8B4513" stroke="#A05213" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Posts -->
    <g stroke="#A05213" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="80"/><line x1="40" y1="0" x2="40" y2="80"/>
      <line x1="80" y1="0" x2="80" y2="80"/><line x1="120" y1="0" x2="120" y2="80"/>
      <line x1="160" y1="0" x2="160" y2="80"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Tiers -->
    <rect x="0" y="25" width="180" height="55" fill="#A05213" opacity="0.85"/>
    <rect x="0" y="45" width="180" height="35" fill="#CD853F" opacity="0.75"/>
    <!-- Crowd -->
    <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="5" cy="35" r="2"/><circle cx="15" cy="35" r="2"/><circle cx="25" cy="35" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="45" cy="35" r="2"/><circle cx="65" cy="35" r="2"/><circle cx="85" cy="35" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="105" cy="35" r="2"/><circle cx="125" cy="35" r="2"/><circle cx="145" cy="35" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="5" cy="55" r="2"/><circle cx="25" cy="55" r="2"/><circle cx="45" cy="55" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="65" cy="55" r="2"/><circle cx="85" cy="55" r="2"/><circle cx="105" cy="55" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="5" cy="75" r="2"/><circle cx="35" cy="75" r="2"/><circle cx="65" cy="75" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="95" cy="75" r="2"/><circle cx="125" cy="75" r="2"/><circle cx="155" cy="75" r="2"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Flags -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="0,0 -8,16 8,16" fill="red" opacity="0.9"/>
      <polygon points="0,0 -8,16 8,16" fill="white" opacity="0.9" transform="translate(0, 16)"/>
      <polygon points="0,0 -8,16 8,16" fill="blue" opacity="0.9" transform="translate(0, 32)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 1: Chestnut with jockey -->
  <g id="horse1" transform="translate(140, 455)">
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="75" ry="38" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
    <!-- Neck -->
    <path d="M75 0 Q 115 -20 140 0 Q 165 -10 180 0" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx="140" cy="0" r="22" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
    <!-- Muzzle -->
    <circle cx="170" cy="-4" r="10" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
    <!-- Ear -->
    <polygon points="135,-20 148,-12 135,-4" fill="url(#horse1Gradient)"/>
    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx="145" cy="3" r="3.5" fill="#000"/>
    
    <!-- Legs with galloping animation -->
    <!-- Front leg 1: extended forward -->
    <g transform="translate(-45, 38)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L 22 35 L 12 45 L 0 38 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Hind leg 1: extended back -->
    <g transform="translate(30, 38)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L -22 35 L -12 45 L 0 38 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Front leg 2: recovery -->
    <g transform="translate(-35, 38)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L 16 28 L 6 38 L 0 32 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Hind leg 2: recovery -->
    <g transform="translate(15, 38)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L -16 28 L -6 38 L 0 32 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Saddle blanket -->
    <path d="M15 15 Q 55 5 95 15 Q 55 25 15 15" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- Saddle number -->
    <text x="92" y="12" font-family="Verdana" font-size="11" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
    
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g transform="translate(70, -12)" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="28" height="42" rx="4"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="18" r="4" fill="#000"/>
      <rect x="8" cy="38" width="14" height="10" fill="#8B4513"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Mane animation -->
    <g fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.3s"
        from="0 140 0" to="360 140 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M140 0 Q 120 -20 100 -10 Q 80 -20 70 0 Q 60 10 50 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Tail animation -->
    <g fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1s"
        from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -35 -20 -55 0 Q -35 20 -10 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Dust puff behind hoof -->
    <g class="dust" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="-60" cy="55" r="7" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="0;-10;0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 2: Bay with jockey -->
  <g id="horse2" transform="translate(300, 445)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="70" ry="35" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
    <path d="M70 0 Q 105 -15 130 0 Q 150 -10 165 0" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="130" cy="0" r="20" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="160" cy="-4" r="8" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
    <polygon points="125,-18 142,-10 125,0" fill="url(#horse2Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="135" cy="2" r="3" fill="#000"/>
    
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g transform="translate(-40, 35)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L 20 32 L 10 42 L 0 36 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(35, 35)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L -20 32 L -10 42 L 0 36 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-30, 35)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L 14 24 L 4 34 L 0 30 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(10, 35)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L -14 24 L -4 34 L 0 30 Z" fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    
    <path d="M12 12 Q 50 2 92 12 Q 50 18 12 12" fill="#F59E0B" opacity="0.85"/>
    <text x="88" y="11" font-family="Verdana" font-size="11" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
    
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g transform="translate(65, -10)" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="28" height="42" rx="4"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="18" r="4" fill="#000"/>
      <rect x="8" cy="38" width="14" height="10" fill="#3B82F6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.1s"
        from="0 130 0" to="360 130 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M130 0 Q 110 -15 90 -5 Q 70 -15 60 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#D2691E" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.9s"
        from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -30 -15 -48 0 Q -15 15 5 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Dust puff -->
    <g class="dust" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="-50" cy="50" r="6" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        dur="1.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="0;-8;0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 3: Black with jockey -->
  <g id="horse3" transform="translate(470, 465)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="65" ry="32" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
    <path d="M65 0 Q 95 -20 120 0 Q 140 -10 155 0" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="120" cy="0" r="18" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="145" cy="-5" r="7" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
    <polygon points="115,-15 128,-7 115,1" fill="url(#horse3Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="125" cy="2" r="3" fill="#fff"/>
    
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g transform="translate(-35, 32)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L 15 28 L 5 35 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(25, 32)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L -15 28 L -5 35 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-20, 32)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L 8 20 L 0 28 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(10, 32)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L -8 20 L 0 28 L 0 32 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    
    <path d="M8 8 Q 48 2 92 8 Q 48 16 8 8" fill="#1A1A1A" opacity="0.95"/>
    <text x="82" y="7" font-family="Verdana" font-size="11" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g transform="translate(55, -8)" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="28" height="42" rx="4"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="18" r="4" fill="#000"/>
      <rect x="8" cy="38" width="14" height="10" fill="#10B981"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.0s"
        from="0 120 0" to="360 120 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M120 0 Q 100 -10 80 -5 Q 60 -10 50 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#2D2D2D" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="0.6s"
        from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -22 -10 -38 0 Q -10 10 2 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Dust puff -->
    <g class="dust" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="-40" cy="45" r="5" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="0;-6;0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 4: Gray with jockey -->
  <g id="horse4" transform="translate(630, 455)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="60" ry="30" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
    <path d="M60 0 Q 85 -10 110 0 Q 130 -5 140 0" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="110" cy="0" r="16" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="135" cy="-3" r="5" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
    <polygon points="108,-10 120,0 108,10" fill="url(#horse4Gradient)"/>
    <circle cx="115" cy="1" r="2.5" fill="#000"/>
    
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g transform="translate(-30, 30)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L 12 25 L 4 32 L 0 28 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(20, 30)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L -12 25 L -4 32 L 0 28 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-15, 30)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L 6 18 L 0 25 L 0 32 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(5, 30)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L -6 18 L 0 25 L 0 32 Z" fill="#E5E5E5" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    
    <path d="M4 4 Q 42 1 82 4 Q 42 15 4 4" fill="#F5F5F5" opacity="0.95"/>
    <text x="78" y="3" font-family="Verdana" font-size="11" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
    
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g transform="translate(45, -7)" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="28" height="42" rx="4"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="18" r="4" fill="#000"/>
      <rect x="8" cy="38" width="14" height="10" fill="#F59E0B"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#F5F5F5" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.6s"
        from="0 110 0" to="360 110 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M110 0 Q 95 -5 80 0 Q 65 -5 50 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#F5F5F5" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.3s"
        from="0 0 0" to="360 0 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M0 0 Q -25 -5 -40 0 Q -5 5 8 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Dust puff -->
    <g class="dust" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="-30" cy="45" r="6" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="0;-5;0"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 5: Dark bay/ brown with jockey (extra horse) -->
  <g id="horse5" transform="translate(780, 460)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="68" ry="36" fill="#6B4423"/>
    <path d="M68 0 Q 100 -20 135 0 Q 165 -10 175 0" fill="#6B4423"/>
    <circle cx="135" cy="0" r="20" fill="#6B4423"/>
    <circle cx="165" cy="-5" r="10" fill="#6B4423"/>
    <polygon points="130,-22 148,-14 130,-4" fill="#6B4423"/>
    <circle cx="140" cy="4" r="3.5" fill="#000"/>
    
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g transform="translate(-42, 35)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L 20 35 L 12 45 L 0 38 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(30, 35)" class="leg1">
      <path d="M0 0 L -20 35 L -12 45 L 0 38 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(-35, 35)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L 14 28 L 6 38 L 0 32 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(20, 35)" class="leg2">
      <path d="M0 0 L -14 28 L -6 38 L 0 32 Z" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.95"/>
    </g>
    
    <path d="M20 18 Q 60 5 105 18 Q 60 25 20 18" fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.85"/>
    <text x="100" y="14" font-family="Verdana" font-size="11" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
    
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g transform="translate(75, -12)" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="28" height="42" rx="4"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="18" r="4" fill="#000"/>
      <rect x="8" cy="38" width="14" height="10" fill="#8B0000"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Mane -->
    <g fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.9">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" dur="1.4s"
        from="0 135 0" to="360 135 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M135 0 Q 115 -15 95 -5 Q 75 -15 55 0"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Tail -->
    <g fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.9">
